run.title: Product Research
assumptions: Product costs are estimates: supplier prices are starting prices before shipping
Ad counts only include ads that use the exact product words, so real numbers can be higher
Green on a map means we found nobody else selling this exact item there, not that nobody does
Lash adhesive is a cosmetic used near the eye: selling in the EU or UK needs a safety assessment and product registration

headline: No clear yes yet, but the peptide body oil is the best lead: one brand has advertised it alone for four months, it is white-label so you can source it, and Germany shows no copies so far.

products.name: Multi-Peptide Body Oil (NØRD BODY)
products.category: Body care: firming and anti-cellulite oil
products.store_products: 16 products, mostly this oil at test prices
products.one_liner: One young brand has advertised this alone for four months, and it is a white-label oil anyone can buy. Copies already sit in Amazon's top results in four countries, but not in Germany.
why: NØRD BODY runs 199 of the 202 ads for "peptide body oil", live since 8 June, about 50 new ads a month
It is a white-label oil: the same bottle and box are on AliExpress without the brand, so you can source it
Germany is clear so far; the UK has it at £11.99 (Amazon result 1) and the US at US$27.80
products.risk: A white-label product can be copied by anyone overnight, and EU cosmetics rules apply before the first sale.
next: Ask the AliExpress supplier whether the oil comes with EU cosmetic safety paperwork (a CPSR) and registration
If yes, test in Germany with German ads: 3 short massage videos, about €20 a day for 5 days
products.best_region: Germany: no copy found by photo or in the top shopper results, and the proof (four months of ads) comes from Australia.

snapshot.cogs: About €5-8 landed from a white-label supplier (estimate, not checked)
snapshot.claims: Triple peptide complex, caffeine, CoQ10; fast-absorbing, non-greasy
snapshot.demoable: Yes: massage ritual and skin-glow close-ups

gates.why: No chain sells this exact bottle; chains sell other body oils such as Bio-Oil

gates.name: Copies gate
gates.why: Cheaper copies in Amazon's top results in Australia, the US, the UK and New Zealand; none found in Germany

gates.why: One brand runs 99% of the ads

gates.why: A 240 ml bottle: light, but a liquid

gates.name: Regulated gate
gates.why: A cosmetic with cellulite and firming claims: EU safety report and registration needed

Post-pregnancy body care for new mums (check ingredient safety)

Bundle with a dry brush or massage roller

compare.note: The same amber pump bottle and box, sold without the brand name on AliExpress and by many sellers on Amazon.

products.advertiser_takeaway: NØRD BODY is alone: 199 of the 202 ads are theirs, running steadily since June. Four months of spending is good proof the ads pay. The only other advertisers (Coco & Eve and two small shops) ran one ad each.

category_notes.ca: The photo search returned no results in Canada.
category_notes.de: dm and Douglas sell other body oils; this exact bottle was not found in Germany.

products.name: Under-Eye CC Cream Compact (DermoCosmetic)
products.store_products: 2 products: this compact and a brush
products.one_liner: One Italian shop has advertised this alone for six months, which is strong proof. But it copies Tarte's best-seller, which Sephora and Ulta sell, and look-alikes cost £6 on Amazon UK.

next: Get a quote for an EU cosmetic safety report and registration from a Responsible Person service
If it is affordable, test a market DermoCosmetic is not in (Spain or Portugal) with your own branding
products.best_region: None of the six. The proof is in Italy, which these checks do not cover; Spain or Portugal would copy that playbook.

products.name: Neck Firming Cream (Mudganics)
products.store_products: 42 products, Australian skincare, also sold wholesale
products.one_liner: The map is green only because this is Mudganics' own formula. Neck creams are a swarm: 40 advertisers, 38 new in two months, and 431,000+ bought on Amazon US last month.

products.name: EMS Lifting Face Mask (Swirise)
products.store_products: 59 products, EMS beauty and wellness devices
products.one_liner: A white-label EMS mask (about US$23 on AliExpress) that Megelin and Amazon sellers already offer, in a busy face-device market led by Silk'n. Hard for a beginner: electrical, a medical-style claim, and high refund risk.
why: The same mask is Amazon US result 3 at US$89.99 and Megelin's at NZ$229 with 300 reviews
Silk'n runs over 100 ads for "EMS face mask" across the UK, Germany and France
